Third-batch plan-repair receipt — 2026-09-05

Audited and repaired exactly four direct children of popular-stretchy-mussel, excluding the eight previously revised aliases. Immutable source basis: origin/main@9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45. All 28 remaining candidates measured 18 file-impact paths, so the tie-break was alias order; the first four were rechecked open, unassigned, and unsigned immediately before mutation.

- aberrant-scabrous-esok (e328-27c5-c7eb-4851): 18 files, 23 blocks (23 docstrings, 0 comment regions; 2,506 before-words).
- biggish-allied-aruanas (a0dd-88d1-a1e1-4797): 18 files, 31 blocks (25 docstrings, 6 comment regions; 2,738 before-words).
- biggish-capturable-magpie (fbb5-46e7-e4bf-4945): 18 files, 32 blocks (28 docstrings, 4 comment regions; 3,672 before-words).
- busy-mirky-borer (029a-c2e8-b4af-44db): 18 files, 36 blocks (26 docstrings, 10 comment regions; 4,132 before-words).

Material repairs: replaced stale numeric ranges with path-qualified D:/C: stable IDs; collapsed composite ranges into maximal token regions; removed incidental imports, decorators, assignments, fixtures, assertions, subprocess arguments, and other executable tails; protected every unlisted concise/load-bearing block and directive line. Revalidation also added two stale operator-attested docstrings after the workflow_ops→decide_ops move and one stale context-hint docstring after removal of the orchestrator binding, while preserving current gate_context, structured_run, budget.pack_container_bins, and verify-identity seams. Consumer searches covered imports, source/path guards, workflow selectors, __doc__, inspect.getdoc, and pydoc; the only target-module import is the owned ensures isolation→late-binding edge, and no target doc consumer was found.

Each description is below 8,000 characters and requires type_comments=True AST equivalence after removing only allowlisted leading docstrings, TypeIgnore.lineno-only normalization, exact non-allowlisted/inline-comment and directive preservation, immutable before/final citations, and one independent-reviewer TSV row per block. MCP persisted description, exact 18-path impact, and exactly five DD commands per leaf; readback matched every payload byte-for-byte (72 path rows, 20 commands). All four remain open, unassigned, and unsigned. No code edit, claim, test/gate/plan review, transition, close, commit, or manual push was performed; only normal MCP tracker-event auto-pushes occurred.
